newsitem.title: UK: Flemings names emerging markets fixed income head.
newsitem.headline: Flemings names emerging markets fixed income head.

text.p: Flemings Investment Management said it had appointed Keith Swabey as head of emerging markets fixed income.
Swabey was previously a director at West Merchant Bank responsible for medium term investments in emerging markets fixed income.
Flemings said Swabey would help expand its capabilities in emerging debt markets, particularly in eastern and central Europe.
It said its fixed income group now managed 14 percent of Robert Fleming & Co's total $99.2 billion in assets under management.
